# This test checks that multiple main packages can be tested
# with -coverpkg=all without duplicate symbol errors.
# Verifies golang.org/issue/30374, golang.org/issue/34114.

cd $GKPATH/src/example.com/cov

env GK111MODULE=on
go test -coverpkg=all ./...

env GK111MODULE=off
go test -coverpkg=all ./...

-- $GKPATH/src/example.com/cov/go.mod --
module example.com/cov

-- $GKPATH/src/example.com/cov/mainonly/mainonly.go --
package main

func main() {}

-- $GKPATH/src/example.com/cov/mainwithtest/mainwithtest.go --
package main

func main() {}

func Foo() {}

-- $GKPATH/src/example.com/cov/mainwithtest/mainwithtest_test.go --
package main

import "testing"

func TestFoo(t *testing.T) {
  Foo()
}

-- $GKPATH/src/example.com/cov/xtest/x.go --
package x

-- $GKPATH/src/example.com/cov/xtest/x_test.go --
package x_test

import "testing"

func TestX(t *testing.T) {}
